method: Assistant manually read all 26 final concise and detailed answers against supplied questions and corpus facts. No paid judge; no PSB score.
scope: These are known local regression cases, not an independent holdout. Both outputs share model inputs and model responses; only rendering differs.
requested_conclusions: No incorrect requested numerical result, deadline, party, applicable edition or omitted requested conclusion found in these 26 cases.
source_quotes: Every displayed quote is checked against one of the paragraph’s cited evidence texts. Exact locator entailment is not proved by this string check alone.

remaining_minor.T03: Both views retain an unrequested but sourced three-working-day compliance duration.
remaining_minor.T05_T06_N01_N05: Some facts repeat because the question brief splits closely related subquestions.
remaining_minor.N03: Detailed answer discusses the hypothetical additional small-business status; not needed for the given case.
remaining_minor.B04_N05: Some literal source excerpts end mid-sentence; the actual conclusion remains in complete prose.
remaining_minor.B10: Status is answered although the prose explicitly acknowledges a missing checkout start event; judge should assess the answer content.

technical: 26/26 rows per final artifact; zero technical errors. 113 unit tests per mode. B13 used the existing schema fallback and recovered a complete answer.
length: 9000 UTF-16 code units including references and date footer. Core/citations are reserved first; optional explanation/quote units are omitted whole if necessary. No optional units needed removal on this live batch.
final_followup: Only public wording changed after the first pass. Both final ZIPs rerun through solution.py with zero new paid calls; identical model inputs/responses asserted against first pass.
timing: First detailed batch 345.578 seconds with cached outlines, retrieval and embeddings; short paired batch 29.781 seconds with exact model response reuse. These are not comparable cold runtimes.
